title: Who will win the women's elite race at the 2026 Sydney Marathon?
background: The Sydney Marathon is an annual road-running event in Australia and part of the World Marathon Majors series.
resolution_criteria: Resolve to the first-place finisher in the elite women's running race at the 2026 Sydney Marathon, excluding wheelchair events. Use the organizer's official race-day results, as confirmed by contemporaneous reporting from major news outlets. Subsequent retrospective changes will not affect resolution. Provide the winning athlete's full name.
